seo.title: Hawaiian Shirt Manufacturer, From 50 Pieces | Tapa Works
seo.description: Tapa Works is a Hawaiian shirt manufacturer and aloha shirt factory in Guangzhou, making custom, private label and OEM/ODM shirts from 50 pieces per style.

hero.heading: Your Label on Every Aloha Shirt
lead: Tapa Works makes private label Hawaiian shirts, swimwear and beach accessories that carry your brand, not ours.

cta.label: Request a quote

blocks.heading: Your Aloha Shirt Factory in Guangzhou
paragraphs: You can order aloha shirts from 50 pieces per style in each colour, a minimum set for small and growing labels. We make every shirt ourselves in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. If you want a first trial run, we agree the quantity with you case by case, within our production limits. Once you approve the sample and we receive your deposit, bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on order size and season.

blocks.heading: An Aloha Shirt Manufacturer That Grows With Your Brand
paragraphs: Early on, we ask whether your shirts are for resort retail, a souvenir programme, matching family sets or a private-label holiday collection, then suggest cuts, fabrics, labelling and packing for that channel. Resort retail needs a full size spread and swing tags, while family sets need the same print across adult and children's sizes.

Our [company and factory background](/about-us/) puts production and export in one business, so quality, cost and delivery have stayed under our direct control since the factory opened in 2011. You agree every order with our team directly, with no online shop or third-party marketplace store.

Our [Product Development](/product-development/) supports OEM and ODM projects from your design, a picture or an idea, with in-house pattern design, grading and fit development. For [Bulk Production](/bulk-production/), our factory makes up to 34,500 pieces a month, and runs above 57,500 units can use our expanded production.

blocks.heading: Fits, Sizes and Fabrics From an OEM Aloha Shirt Manufacturer
columns: What it means for your order
rows: We make aloha shirts for men, women and children in 4 cuts: classic loose men's/unisex, shaped women's, tailored slim men's and women's vintage.

If you're selling to a mixed audience, we recommend this true-to-size cut. It's relaxed through the chest and shoulders and forgiving across different body shapes, so you get fewer fit complaints. If you pick it over the women's fit, you give up the defined waist and shorter body length.
If your collection is aimed specifically at women, this closer-fitting cut gives you the waist definition and shorter body that the unisex cut lacks.
If your collection is aimed specifically at men who want a slimmer silhouette, we recommend this tailored cut over the relaxed unisex option.
This version comes with a mandarin collar and cap sleeves.

We grade each cut across 47 measurement points. Adult unisex and women's shirts are graded XS to 3XL on the standard chart, extended sizes take the range from XXS to 5XL, and youth, kids' and seniors' sizing is available too. Every order comes with a size chart showing chest, length and sleeve measurements.
Our range includes camp collar shirts, resort polos, children's versions, structured shirts and smooth woven shirts.

Our [Hawaiian Fabrics](/hawaiian-fabrics/) include cotton, polyester, spandex, nylon, rayon, viscose, modal, Tencel, linen, silk and wool. There are drapey and performance-stretch options, plus blends including 95% cotton 5% spandex, 80% nylon 20% spandex and 65% polyester 35% cotton.
Through [Customisation](/customization/), we welcome requests for custom-tailored aloha shirts, including options not listed here, and our team will assess them for you.

For [Matching Family & Group Sets](/matching-family-group-sets/), we carry your aloha print across sizes from toddler up to 5XL. We scale the artwork to each garment size so the print lines up the same way on every piece.
Our [Cut & Sew](/cut-sew/) service works from custom patterns and cuts every panel precisely.

Through [Fabric Sourcing](/fabric-sourcing/), we buy from textile suppliers and certified mills that have proved reliable for us. We source moisture-wicking, UV-protective, anti-odour and sustainable fabrics for your shirts.
For [Garment Dyeing](/garment-dyeing/), we match your Pantone reference or physical swatch and get your approval on lab dips before bulk production. Finishes and treatments are available too.

Our [Trims & Accessories](/trims-accessories/) service helps you compare button material, size, colour and attachment and choose plackets and brand details. You can also pick metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly accessories colour-matched to your fabric and prints, custom hardware included.

For [Custom Buttons](/custom-buttons/), custom-dyed or logo-engraved buttons have the button maker's own minimum of 1,000 pieces per design in each colour. We order these as a separate lot and keep the spares for your reorders. For smaller runs, we colour-match stock buttons, which have no separate minimum and work at the 50-piece shirt minimum.

blocks.heading: A recent order

items.text: An Australian resort wear label took its first capsule from moodboards to bulk with our in-house design and fit team. Sample rounds per style dropped from 4 to 2, and the time from brief to approved sample fell from 9 weeks to 4.

A 14-store West Coast boutique chain moved its aloha shirt programme to our staged QC with independent pre-shipment inspection. Defects found at its receiving check fell from 6.8% to 1.2%, and fit and shrinkage returns fell from 9% to 3%.

items.question: Do you print the Hawaiian fabrics yourselves, or do you buy printed fabric from mills?
items.answer: We do screen, DTF and sublimation printing ourselves, in our own factory. You can also choose DTG and specialty printing, printed or embroidered logos, digital and hand embroidery, and finishing treatments such as dye washes and garment washing.

items.question: Can you turn my own artwork into an original aloha print, and will that print belong only to my brand?
items.answer: Yes. We turn your artwork into an original aloha print that stays your intellectual property, and we never sell a print made exclusively for you to another client. We take your sketches, moodboards or references and develop them into production-ready repeat artwork. That means we separate the colours, set up the repeats, scale them to the garment type, refine the placement and prepare 3D mockups. We also sign a non-disclosure agreement to protect your designs and business information. We plan pattern matching at the artwork stage. Before sampling, we set the repeat size and panel placement so the print runs continuously across the collar, placket, pocket and hem. Misalignment can't be fixed once the panels are cut, so matching has to be built into the repeat and cutting plan from the start.

items.question: How do you check the goods during sewing and before they ship, and what happens if a batch fails?
items.answer: Our own QC team inspects your shirts in-line while they're being sewn, and our multi-stage checks finish with a 100% final garment inspection. You're welcome to bring in independent inspectors, including SGS or BV, before shipment. You book and pay the agency directly and give us at least 3 business days' notice of the inspection date. If the goods fail because of our workmanship, we rework them and pay the re-inspection fee.

seo.title: Big and Tall Aloha Shirt Manufacturer: 2XL-5XL | Tapa Works
seo.description: Extended sizes from a big and tall aloha shirt manufacturer: customisation, wholesale ordering from 50 pieces and clear sample fees.

hero.heading: Big and Tall Aloha Shirt Manufacturer
lead: Your brand gets roomier fits built to your own specification, with the same finish in every size.

cta.label: Request a quote for big & tall aloha shirts

blocks.heading: Big and Tall Aloha Shirt Manufacturing in China
paragraphs: Our premium aloha shirts come in sizes [XXS to 5XL](/), so you can stock larger sizes next to standard ones in the same collection. They come in four cuts: unisex/men’s, men’s slim fit, women’s and women’s vintage. If you’re looking for an OEM big and tall aloha shirt manufacturer that makes its shirts itself, we produce every one in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

blocks.heading: Custom Big and Tall Aloha Shirts, Made for Your Collection
columns: What we provide for your collection
rows: Before bulk cutting, we measure a finished sample in each extended size against your chart, checking chest, body length, shoulder width and sleeve length point by point. Neighbouring big sizes differ by small increments. When grading or sewing errors wipe out those differences, two sizes fit almost the same. Checking finished garments catches that loss of separation.

Finished chest measurements for 2XL, 3XL, 4XL and 5XL are 132, 140, 148 and 156 cm; body lengths are 80, 82, 84 and 86 cm; short-sleeve lengths are 26, 27, 28 and 29 cm; and shoulder widths are 54, 56, 58 and 60 cm. Across 2XL to 5XL, we keep short-sleeve length within ±0.5 cm of your chart, measured from shoulder seam to sleeve hem, so each sleeve length stays distinct.

Through our [Product Development](/product-development/) service, we handle OEM and ODM work from your design, picture or idea. Our in-house team takes care of patterns, grading and fit development, which cuts down design back-and-forth.

With [Custom Print Design](/custom-print-design/), we turn your sketches, moodboards or references into exclusive resort repeats. We separate colours, scale the artwork, refine placement and prepare 3D mockups, and we align the pattern across collar, placket, pocket and hem.

Our [Custom Printing](/custom-printing/) service adjusts repeat, scale and placement to suit the style, calibrates colours on stretch fabrics to reduce print deviation and gives you pre-production strike-offs to approve.

With [Matching Family & Group Sets](/matching-family-group-sets/), your aloha print runs from toddler sizes up to 5XL. We scale the artwork to each garment size so the alignment stays consistent across the set.
With [Cut & Sew](/cut-sew/), we take your DXF patterns through two rounds of pre-production samples, adjust the patterns and machines, and regrade the full size range.

Our [Embroidery](/embroidery/) service covers intricate decoration prepared by designers, plus patches and labels, along with screen-printing options. Our embroidered logos hold up to repeated washing and hard wear without fraying.
With [Garment Dyeing](/garment-dyeing/), we match your Pantone colours at no extra charge and give you one round of lab dips to approve before bulk production.
Through [Sampling](/sampling/), you approve fit against a measurement sheet, not photos alone, and we offer live fitting videos. Courier delivery of samples costs you USD 50 on top of the sample fee.

Our [women’s Hawaiian shirts](/women-s-hawaiian-shirt-manufacturer/) use a dedicated women’s block for both women’s cuts. Bust darts, contoured side seams and a curved hem keep the bust, waist and hip shaping all the way to 5XL. You can also choose closer-fitting princess seams or a relaxed dropped shoulder with gentle waist shaping.

blocks.heading: Wholesale Aloha Shirts: Start With 50 Pieces per Style and Colour
columns: What it means for your order
rows: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, which gives small and growing labels a way in. We agree a first trial run with you case by case, and what production allows sets its quantity.

A standard sample is ready in 10 to 15 days. Bulk production takes 35 to 40 days once the sample is approved and your deposit arrives. Order size and season decide where your order falls in that range.
We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. [DDP delivery is available worldwide](/shipping/), with duties, customs and freight in one price.

Our [company and factory](/about-us/) has run production and export as one business since 2011, so quality, cost and delivery stay under our direct control. Our full-package service covers patterns, tech pack help, sourcing, sampling, printing, grading, branding, eco-friendly packaging and bulk production. You agree every B2B order directly with us through our website or team, not through an online shop or third-party marketplace.
[Contact our team](/contact-us/) and you’ll hear back within one business day. English-speaking support is available by phone or video call at every stage.

Our [production process](/our-process/) keeps sample approval and bulk approval separate. It starts with consultation, technical review and tech pack preparation. Then come garment and material choices, artwork-scale and real-garment print checks, sample revisions, and approval of design, fabric, fit and branding. You then sign off on quantity, size split, quality checkpoints, carton packing and shipping terms before we cut, stitch, finish and dispatch.
With our [Packaging](/packaging/) service, you can mix size ratios within the same style and colour in each carton at no extra charge, such as an S:M:L:XL ratio of 1:2:2:1.

With our [Private Label](/private-label/) service, we keep our name off your garments, and we build your collection’s branding around your logo, colours and messaging. We coordinate your approved woven, printed or silicone labels, patches, embroidery, hang tags, care labels, barcode and size stickers, chosen buttons, accessories and marketing materials. We also handle individual polybags, size sorting, carton marks and retail-ready packaging to your specifications.

With [Trims & Accessories](/trims-accessories/), we help you compare button material, size, colour and attachment and pick placket and packaging details. We also tie your branding together with colour-matched metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly accessories and custom hardware.

Our [Shipping](/shipping/) service delivers to buyers in the United States, Hawaii, Canada, Australia, the Caribbean, the UK and Europe by express, air, sea or door-to-door delivery. We choose the transport that suits your order size and timeline.

blocks.heading: Why Do Sizes 2XL to 5XL Cost More?
paragraphs: Each 2XL to 5XL piece costs more because it takes more fabric, has a larger print area and needs an extra button on the longer placket. We show you a separate extended-size price tier before sampling. Pricing these sizes separately, at cost and retail, keeps their margins visible. Averaging them into one style price hides size-level margins and gets less accurate as your size mix shifts.

blocks.heading: What Do Samples Cost, and When Do You Pay?
paragraphs: Each sample costs USD 50. You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before shipment.
rows: You pay a design fee of USD 50 per design. It covers the design's pattern or print in all its colourways. Sample and design fees aren't refunded, and they aren't credited against your bulk order.

When you [request a quote](/request-a-quote/), we review your design and fabric choice and send you an itemised, no-obligation price within 24 hours. We base that price on quantity, construction, design complexity, fabric type and availability, lining, print method, logo application, labels, branding, packaging, size ratio and lead time.

For [Custom Buttons](/custom-buttons/), custom-dyed or logo-engraved buttons have their own minimum of 1,000 pieces per design in each colour, set by the button maker, and we store the spares for your reorders. Colour-matched stock buttons have no separate minimum, so they work at the 50-piece shirt minimum.

Our [Hawaiian Fabrics](/hawaiian-fabrics/) range covers cotton, polyester, spandex, nylon, rayon, viscose, modal, Tencel, linen, silk and wool. It also includes blends such as 95% cotton 5% spandex, 80% nylon 20% spandex and 65% polyester 35% cotton. Every fabric comes preshrunk, and there's a lightweight, breathable, wrinkle-resistant comfort-stretch option.

With our [Fabric Sourcing](/fabric-sourcing/) service, you can also choose drapey rayon, performance stretch, recycled polyester (RPET), organic cotton, Better Cotton (BCI) fabric and custom fabric development. We use sustainable fabrics wherever possible.

Our [Quality Control](/quality-control/) service checks incoming fabric, cutting and sewing, and we run random checks along the way. Before packing, we measure and inspect every finished shirt against your approved specifications and sample. Before dispatch, we audit workmanship, labelling and packaging and send you photos of the finished goods. You're welcome to bring in independent SGS or BV inspection. Tested fabrics and trims carry OEKO-TEX Standard 100, organic cotton styles carry GOTS, cotton comes through Better Cotton (BCI), and our factory holds ISO 9001 and WRAP. Finished chest, length and waist stay within ±1 cm of your chart, and collar, cuff and other small points stay within ±0.5 cm. Residual shrinkage stays within 3% in length and width after three home washes. Washing colourfastness is Grade 4 or above, including high-twist chiffon, and rubbing and light colourfastness are Grade 3–4 or above.

Through [Custom Labels & Hang Tags](/custom-labels-hang-tags/), we draft fibre content, care symbols and country of origin from the actual materials, and we add your RN or CA number where it's needed. We base care instructions on fabric and print wash tests. We follow your destination's requirements, including US FTC, EU and UK fibre-name rules and Australian care-labelling rules. We get your approval on the artwork before production, and we check the labels on every private-label order.

Under our [Terms and Conditions](/terms-and-conditions/), you report any quality problem within 7 days and send photos or videos. We review the evidence and get back to you within 24 hours with a solution: repair, remake, replacement, discount or credit.

blocks.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Do you offer tall sizing with a longer body and sleeves, separate from the big sizes?
items.answer: Yes. Our tall sizes run from LT to 4XLT. We grade them separately from our big sizes, so you get extra length without extra width. Each tall size adds 5 cm to body length and 3 cm to sleeve length over the matching regular size, and we also offer different length increments to match your size chart. Your customers' fit feedback tells you which range they need: tall sizing adds length, and big sizing adds room in the chest and shoulders. If you stock tall sizes instead of the matching big sizes, your customers get extra length but lose the additional chest, shoulder and waist room. Choose the wrong range and the shirt ends up too short or too baggy.

items.question: Is your big & tall range suited to specialty big & tall retailers and to uniform programmes that must cover every staff size?
items.answer: Yes. We build the range for specialty big & tall retailers, for resort and surf shops that carry extended sizes, and for uniform or staff programmes that need XXS to 5XL in one matching print and fit. Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour, and you can spread them across 3 to 4 sizes at no extra charge. That way you cover the larger sizes without ordering a full run of each one.

items.question: Are your 2XL–5XL shirts graded with their own proportions and construction details, or just scaled up from the standard pattern?
items.answer: We grade 2XL–5XL shirts to their own big & tall proportions. We don't just scale up the standard pattern. We set chest, shoulder width, armhole depth, waist ease, body length and sleeve length separately for every size. From 2XL up, we lengthen the front placket and add one extra button. We also cut 6 cm side vents and place the chest pocket lower and further out to suit a larger frame.

blocks.heading: Private Label Women's Hawaiian Shirts in Your Fit and Style
columns: What we make for your collection
rows: We build women's and women's vintage cuts on a block made for women. We don't scale down a unisex or men's pattern. The shape comes from bust darts, contoured side seams and a curved hem. Princess seams give you a closer, more tailored line, but you lose the relaxed dropped-shoulder cut's forgiving fit across more body shapes. Before grading, we check small, mid and plus-size samples so bust, waist and hip shaping stay in proportion all the way to 5XL.

As well as the classic camp collar, you can choose cropped, tie-front, sleeveless, longline and shirt-dress versions. Shirt dresses and longline cover-ups sell best in resort ranges. Cropped and tie-front cuts suit younger boutique customers, and sleeveless styles suit hot-climate markets.

Our in-house Product Development team takes on OEM and ODM work from your design, picture or idea. We develop patterns, fit and custom grading to your specifications. The standard range runs XS to 3XL on US, EU and UK charts, and [extended sizes](/) are available.

With Cut & Sew, your DXF patterns go through two sample rounds, pattern and machine adjustments and full-range regrading. At sampling, we pick the collar and placket interlining: lightweight fusible, soft non-fused or none. Lightweight rayon gets 1 cm overlocked or French seams, tested to ISO 13936-2 with no more than 6 mm opening.

With Custom Print Design, we turn your sketches, moodboards or references into exclusive repeats that are ready for production. We handle colour separation, scale the artwork to the garment, refine placement and make 3D mockups. The pattern lines up across collar, placket, pocket and hem.

In Custom Printing, we calibrate colours for stretch fabric and offer strike-offs for your approval. Rayon, cotton, linen and silk are screen- or digitally printed on the roll. Sublimation needs a light-coloured fabric with at least 60% polyester. Placement prints use cut panels, and reverse prints use cotton. Dark grounds are dyed before screen printing or digitally printed in full. Repeats go up to 64 cm for screen printing, or the full 150 cm printable width for digital and sublimation. Large repeats or pattern matching use 10–15% more fabric, and that's already in your unit price.

For matching family and group sets, from toddler sizes to 5XL, we scale the artwork and sample the whole set together. A print never comes out identical on different fabric bases. So we match every base to one Pantone reference, and you approve them side by side before bulk.
Our Embroidery service covers detailed decoration, patches and labels. Our team prepares the designs, and embroidered logos are made to stand up to repeated washing and hard wear.
With Garment Dyeing, we match your Pantone reference or physical swatch and get your lab-dip approval before bulk. Finishes and treatments are available too.

Our Private Label service puts only your brand on the collection. We coordinate your approved woven, printed, heat-transfer or silicone labels, logo patches, care wording, tags and branded retail materials to suit your style and fabric.

Through Trims & Accessories, we help you choose button material, size, colour and attachment, as well as plackets and brand details. Colour-matched metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly accessories and custom hardware are available.

For Custom Buttons, custom-dyed or logo-engraved designs need a separate lot of 1,000 pieces per design in each colour. We store the spares for your reorders. Colour-matched stock buttons have no separate minimum and work at the 50-piece shirt minimum.
Our Packaging service folds and barcodes each shirt, seals it in its own polybag and adds the branded insert card you supply. Brand labels make the goods retail-ready.

blocks.heading: How Are Your Shirts Tested, Washed and Labelled?
paragraphs: Before production, we wash-test your actual bulk fabric and print and write the care label from those results, because stretch yarns and printed colours react to heat and agitation differently from plain cotton.
To keep the stretch and colour, your customers machine wash inside out at 30°C on a gentle cycle without bleach, then line dry in shade or tumble dry on low.

Our [Quality Control service](/quality-control/) tests shrinkage and colour bleed before sampling, with a limit of 3% in length and width after three home washes, and welcomes SGS or BV inspection. Through [Custom Labels & Hang Tags](/custom-labels-hang-tags/), we prepare fibre content, tested care instructions, origin and any required RN or CA number for you to approve.

Under our [terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions/), you report any quality problem within 7 days of delivery with photos or videos, and we offer a repair, remake, replacement, discount or credit.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: How do you prevent the comfort-stretch shirts from becoming permanently loose at the bust or elbows after repeated wear?
items.answer: We keep spandex at 3–5% and use core-spun stretch yarns, so the fabric springs back and doesn't slowly loosen. We also leave enough room at the elbow to avoid constant strain.

items.question: Which lightweight fabric options keep pale or white-ground women's shirts opaque without a lining, including when stretched across the bust?
items.answer: For an unlined shirt with a pale or white ground, we use the heavier end of our ranges. That means 120–130 gsm rayon or polyester, 130–140 gsm cotton poplin, or a tighter-weave comfort-stretch blend. Before bulk production, we check opacity on your sample with the fabric stretched across the bust.

items.question: How prone is the comfort-stretch fabric to pilling under arms or bag straps, and what fabric choices or finishes do you offer to reduce it?
items.answer: Our comfort-stretch fabric is smooth and tightly woven, so it pills much less than knitted stretch fabrics. That holds where underarms and bag straps rub, too. For heavy-wear styles, you can cut surface fuzz further with compact-spun cotton yarns, an anti-pilling enzyme finish or a denser 130 gsm weave.

items.question: Can you make matching shorts, skirts or dresses in the same print as the women's shirt so I can sell co-ord sets?
items.answer: Yes. We make shorts, skirts and dresses in the same print as your women's shirt, so you can sell them as co-ord sets.

items.question: How do you stop the buttons gaping at the bust on a fitted women's shirt?
items.answer: We put one button level with the bust point and space the rest 6 to 7 cm apart. We also grade at least 8 cm of ease over your bust measurement. Before we lock the bulk pattern, we check button placement and bust ease on someone who is moving. Reaching and sitting show strain that a flat sample doesn't.

items.question: Which women's design details or fabric choices make the unit price go up compared with a basic camp-collar shirt?
items.answer: Your unit price goes up with princess seams, bust and back darts, front ties, ruffles, puff sleeves, longer tunic or dress lengths, and stretch grades such as 95% cotton 5% spandex. Compared with a basic camp-collar shirt, each one adds fabric, sewing time or material cost.

blocks.heading: Resort Dress Fabrics and Lining Choices
rows: You can choose from smooth lightweight wovens, rayon, viscose-feel and chiffon-like fabrics, cotton blends, stretch poplin, knitted blends, satin, lightweight crepe, mesh, lace trims and prints. For a premium line, there are linen, silk blends and embroidery.
For flowing silhouettes, choose non-stretch 100% rayon challis at 100–130 GSM, 100% viscose crepe or twill at 120–160 GSM, or modal or Tencel blends at 130–160 GSM.
For body-skimming pull-on styles, we offer 95% viscose 5% spandex and 92% modal 8% spandex knit blends at 160–200 GSM, which give about 25–40% four-way stretch.

Cotton voile breathes best and clings least. 100% polyester habotai at 60–80 GSM is light and smooth but builds static in dry air. Viscose lining feels soft and cool, and stretch mesh moves with knitted or close-fitting bodies.
We line slips, sundresses, chiffon, lace and light-coloured dresses as standard. You choose full lining, bodice lining, hip half-lining or self-lining, in a colour matched to the shell or in nude.
We settle the lining on your first sample, checking it against the shell for breathability, weight, stretch, smoothness, static, shrinkage and colour.

To help you compare fabrics, our [Hawaiian Fabrics service](/hawaiian-fabrics/) offers soft-draping rayon, crisper cotton, premium-feel linen blends, and faster-drying, easier-care polyester and smooth wovens.

Our [Fabric Sourcing service](/fabric-sourcing/) widens your options to performance stretch, recycled polyester (RPET), organic cotton, Better Cotton (BCI) and custom fabrics, and we use sustainable fabrics wherever feasible.

blocks.heading: Colour Selection, Fastness Tests and Fabric Standards
rows: You pick from more than 45 colours, and we approve each colour on the actual dress fabric before bulk, never from a screen or a different fabric.

Our [Quality Control standards](/quality-control/) test washing to ISO 105-C06, rubbing to ISO 105-X12 and light to ISO 105-B02. Washing fastness reaches Grade 4 or above, high-twist chiffon included, and rubbing and light reach Grade 3–4 or above. Finished chest, length and waist stay within ±1 cm and small points within ±0.5 cm. Residual shrinkage in length and width stays within 3% after three home washes. Tested fabrics and trims carry OEKO-TEX Standard 100, organic cotton styles carry GOTS, cotton comes through Better Cotton (BCI), and our factory holds ISO 9001 and WRAP.

Our [Garment Dyeing service](/garment-dyeing/) works from Pantone Coated or stock colour cards and develops custom shades. The fabric and dye method set the minimum, we confirm feasibility during sampling, and we coordinate colour across shell, lining and trims.

blocks.heading: Custom Resort Dress Prints and Placement Alignment
paragraphs: We develop floral, tropical, border, gradient and digital prints, or a solid-colour resort story, and we approve a strike-off on your actual dress fabric. Our [Custom Print Design service](/custom-print-design/) turns your references into exclusive, production-ready repeats or placement layouts, and it handles colour separation, garment-scaled artwork, alignment and 3D mockups. Through our [Custom Printing service](/custom-printing/), we screen-print or digitally print rayon, cotton and linen on the roll before cutting, which gives saturated colour and a natural hand. Sublimation is limited to light-coloured polyester or blends with at least 60% polyester, and it gives sharper brights and a slightly crisper fall.

All-over repeats use less fabric and cost less. Engineered placement and border prints make the print the defining feature of your dress, but they use more fabric on long or tiered skirts. Matched tiers need extra allowance, one-way layouts can't be nested head to tail, wide panels occupy the roll width, and each size needs its own print file. For placement prints, we use high-precision digital printing and cut by hand so floral motifs line up symmetrically across seams and around waist cut-outs.

blocks.heading: Private Label Resort Dresses: Construction and Finishing
rows: Relaxed beach styles use shirred backs and ties, while fitted and slip styles use invisible zips and sliders. Halters take neck ties, hooks or button tabs. You can also choose button fronts, keyhole loops, fixed spaghetti straps 0.5–1.5 cm wide and 4–8 rows of shirring elastic.

We bind and bar-tack waist-ring joins and cut-outs, and we hang maxis for 24 hours before hemming them. Hems are narrow 0.6 cm double-turn or rolled, and we wash-test your first sample three times to check that seams and hems stay straight.

Our [Cut & Sew service](/cut-sew/) sews lightweight rayon with 1 cm overlocked or French seams, tested to ISO 13936-2 with no more than 6 mm opening. For silk and very fine fabrics, it offers flat-felled or narrow 0.6 cm French seams.

Our [Trims & Accessories service](/trims-accessories/) coordinates button material, size, colour and attachment, along with plackets and brand details, and matches metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly accessories to your fabric and prints.

Our [Custom Buttons service](/custom-buttons/) needs 1,000 custom-dyed or logo-engraved buttons per design in each colour, and we store the spares for your reorders. Colour-matched stock buttons have no separate minimum and work at our 50-piece minimum.
Our [Private Label service](/private-label/) is available at every quantity. It covers woven, printed and heat-transfer labels, hang tags, metal tags, logo application and silicone branding.

Our [Custom Labels & Hang Tags service](/custom-labels-hang-tags/) drafts fibre content, wash-tested care instructions, origin and the required RN or CA details to your destination's rules, and you approve them before production. Every private-label order goes through QC.

Our [Packaging service](/packaging/) provides custom bags, eco packs, boxes, gift packaging or neutral export packing, sorted to your distribution requirements. It also handles steam pressing, folding, barcode labels, carton marks and shipping preparation.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: What bust, waist, hip and finished-length measurements define your adult and girls' dress sizes, and how much wearing ease does each silhouette allow?
items.answer: Dresses keep their own chart, XS to 4XL, covering bust 82–126 cm, waist 64–108 cm and hip 88–132 cm. Girls' sizes go from 2T with a 53 cm chest up to 14 with an 80 cm chest. Finished lengths are about 90 cm for minis, 110–115 cm for midis and 135–145 cm for maxis. Slip and fitted cuts get about 2–4 cm of bust ease, wrap and shirt dresses 6–10 cm, and tiered and kaftan styles 12 cm or more. We can also work to your own size chart.

items.question: Can I take one of your dress silhouettes and change its length, neckline or sleeves, or add pockets or tiers?
items.answer: Yes. We can change the length, neckline, sleeves, fabric or colour, and add pockets, tiers or ruffles. Our in-house team revises the existing pattern, we quote you before sampling, and your new sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.

items.question: Which design choices on a resort dress raise the price most, for example a maxi length, tiers, a full lining or a placement print?
items.answer: Fabric use has the biggest effect on price. Maxis, multiple tiers, ruffles and matched placement or border prints cost more than minis or midis with all-over repeats. Full lining, embroidery and built-in cups add materials and sewing time, and we itemise each option you choose.

items.question: Which of your fabrics suit close-fitting slip dresses, gathered tiered dresses and structured shirt dresses without compromising their intended shape?
items.answer: For close-fitting slips we use fluid silk blends, rayon, chiffon and satin. Light cotton voile and lawn hold the volume of gathered tiers without adding bulk. Cotton poplin, stretch poplin, linen and viscose shirting keep the collars, plackets and bodies of shirt dresses crisp.

items.question: Can you make bias-cut satin or silk-blend slip dresses, and what fabric or design restrictions apply?
items.answer: Yes. We cut polyester, viscose and silk-blend satin at 70–120 GSM on the true bias, one layer at a time, then hang each dress for 24 hours before we level the hem. Bias cutting uses about 20–30% more fabric than straight-grain cutting, and it suits all-over or small-repeat prints, not borders or placements. Fabrics under 60 GSM or with more than 5% spandex don't work for bias cutting.

items.question: Do you offer both adjustable true-wrap dresses and fixed faux-wrap dresses, and which fastening options are available for each?
items.answer: Yes. True wraps fit a wide size range, with an adjustable self-tie that passes through a side-seam opening and an internal snap or hook-and-eye at the inner crossover. Faux wraps have a fixed neckline and are sewn closed at the waist. They pull on or use a side zip, and you can add a hidden press stud at the bust overlap.

items.question: Can you incorporate sewn-in cups or an internal support layer into backless and low-neckline resort dresses, and what support constructions fall outside your capability?
items.answer: Yes. We offer fixed or removable moulded cups, hidden power-mesh support, clear stabilising tape at the neckline, bodice lining and light spiral boning, and we pick what suits your design. We don't make fully corseted bodices, underwired cups or structured bra frames, so a dress that needs that level of support has to be worn with a separate strapless bra.

items.question: Can you combine a knitted bodice with a woven skirt or add mesh and lace panels, and what material combinations are outside your production capabilities?
items.answer: Yes. We join knitted bodices to woven skirts with stretch stay tape at the waist. We also add mesh overlays, sleeves, cut-out fills, ruching or illusion panels, as well as lace trims and inserts. We don't combine fabrics with conflicting care needs, such as dry-clean-only silk or wool with washable knits, and we don't work with leather, sequinned panels or bonded seams.

mainEntity.name: What bust, waist, hip and finished-length measurements define your adult and girls' dress sizes, and how much wearing ease does each silhouette allow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dresses keep their own chart, XS to 4XL, covering bust 82–126 cm, waist 64–108 cm and hip 88–132 cm. Girls' sizes go from 2T with a 53 cm chest up to 14 with an 80 cm chest. Finished lengths are about 90 cm for minis, 110–115 cm for midis and 135–145 cm for maxis. Slip and fitted cuts get about 2–4 cm of bust ease, wrap and shirt dresses 6–10 cm, and tiered and kaftan styles 12 cm or more. We can also work to your own size chart.

mainEntity.name: Can I take one of your dress silhouettes and change its length, neckline or sleeves, or add pockets or tiers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can change the length, neckline, sleeves, fabric or colour, and add pockets, tiers or ruffles. Our in-house team revises the existing pattern, we quote you before sampling, and your new sample is ready in 10 to 15 days.

mainEntity.name: Which design choices on a resort dress raise the price most, for example a maxi length, tiers, a full lining or a placement print?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fabric use has the biggest effect on price. Maxis, multiple tiers, ruffles and matched placement or border prints cost more than minis or midis with all-over repeats. Full lining, embroidery and built-in cups add materials and sewing time, and we itemise each option you choose.

mainEntity.name: Which of your fabrics suit close-fitting slip dresses, gathered tiered dresses and structured shirt dresses without compromising their intended shape?

acceptedAnswer.text: For close-fitting slips we use fluid silk blends, rayon, chiffon and satin. Light cotton voile and lawn hold the volume of gathered tiers without adding bulk. Cotton poplin, stretch poplin, linen and viscose shirting keep the collars, plackets and bodies of shirt dresses crisp.

mainEntity.name: Can you make bias-cut satin or silk-blend slip dresses, and what fabric or design restrictions apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We cut polyester, viscose and silk-blend satin at 70–120 GSM on the true bias, one layer at a time, then hang each dress for 24 hours before we level the hem. Bias cutting uses about 20–30% more fabric than straight-grain cutting, and it suits all-over or small-repeat prints, not borders or placements. Fabrics under 60 GSM or with more than 5% spandex don't work for bias cutting.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer both adjustable true-wrap dresses and fixed faux-wrap dresses, and which fastening options are available for each?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. True wraps fit a wide size range, with an adjustable self-tie that passes through a side-seam opening and an internal snap or hook-and-eye at the inner crossover. Faux wraps have a fixed neckline and are sewn closed at the waist. They pull on or use a side zip, and you can add a hidden press stud at the bust overlap.

mainEntity.name: Can you incorporate sewn-in cups or an internal support layer into backless and low-neckline resort dresses, and what support constructions fall outside your capability?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer fixed or removable moulded cups, hidden power-mesh support, clear stabilising tape at the neckline, bodice lining and light spiral boning, and we pick what suits your design. We don't make fully corseted bodices, underwired cups or structured bra frames, so a dress that needs that level of support has to be worn with a separate strapless bra.

mainEntity.name: Can you combine a knitted bodice with a woven skirt or add mesh and lace panels, and what material combinations are outside your production capabilities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We join knitted bodices to woven skirts with stretch stay tape at the waist. We also add mesh overlays, sleeves, cut-out fills, ruching or illusion panels, as well as lace trims and inserts. We don't combine fabrics with conflicting care needs, such as dry-clean-only silk or wool with washable knits, and we don't work with leather, sequinned panels or bonded seams.

items.heading: Lengths and silhouettes
paragraphs: We make mini, short, midi, long and maxi dresses, beach maxis and cover-ups included, in wrap, A-line, tunic, shirt-dress, loose-fit and oversized resort silhouettes built to your specifications.

paragraphs: You choose sleeveless, halter, off-shoulder or puff-sleeved tops, finished with smocking, tiers, ruffles or embroidery. Plus-size and modest versions let you build a varied range with us.

items.heading: Warm-weather and event ranges
paragraphs: We develop summer, casual, sundress, vacation and resort ranges, plus luau, party, cocktail, evening, wedding-guest and bridesmaid pieces, in vintage, boho, elegant, designer or tropical-print looks.

items.heading: Matching family ranges
paragraphs: Our [Matching Family & Group Sets service](/matching-family-group-sets/) carries the same aloha print from toddler sizes up to 5XL. We scale the artwork to each garment size, so the print lines up consistently across the whole set.

items.heading: Our strongest sellers
paragraphs: Luau, summer, sundress, casual, party, boho and vacation styles sell best for us, along with long, short and off-shoulder cuts.

items.heading: Wholesale stock selection
paragraphs: Our Hawaiian dress stock includes tropical-print maxi, sundress and off-shoulder styles in hibiscus, palm-leaf and floral prints. Ask us for the current stock list to see what's available.

items.heading: Stock versus made-to-order
paragraphs: Stock dresses ship sooner and let you test demand before you move proven sellers into made-to-order production. The trade-off is that with stock you accept existing prints, cuts and sizing, not the exclusive design and fit of your own specification.

blocks.heading: Custom Dress Construction, Trims and Finishes
columns: What we make and what it means for your range
rows: For wholesale lines across a full size run, we stitch the wrap front in place and tack the openings closed. That keeps the neckline, skirt opening and fit consistent, but you lose the adjustable waist and the relaxed, tied look of a true wrap.

The fronts overlap fully and tie at the waist, so the wearer adjusts the dress to her body shape or between sizes. We cut at least 10 cm of overlap at the waist so it stays covered during movement, and we can add an inner tie or snap.
We shirr the panels with 1 mm covered elastic thread in rows 8–10 mm apart, then steam-set them. Every sample is stretched 50 times to confirm it returns to within 1 cm of its relaxed width.
We gather on two rows of stitching, join the tiers with overlocked seams, topstitch the seams flat and finish with a narrow rolled hem.
We stitch embroidered trims over a soft stabiliser, so they lie flat after washing.

Our [Trims & Accessories service](/trims-accessories/) helps you choose button material, size, colour and attachment, as well as plackets and brand details. Metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly accessories are colour-matched to your fabrics and prints.

With our [Custom Buttons service](/custom-buttons/), custom-dyed or logo-engraved buttons need a separate lot of 1,000 pieces per design in each colour, and we store the spares for your reorders. Colour-matched stock buttons have no separate minimum and work at your garment minimum.

blocks.heading: Hawaiian Print Dresses: Fabric and Colour Choices
paragraphs: We choose the fabric to suit your silhouette, then sample your print on that exact base, so you approve the drape and colour together before bulk production.

items.heading: Lightweight non-stretch cover-ups
paragraphs: For airy, non-stretch beach cover-ups, we supply polyester and high-twist chiffon at 60–90 GSM, cotton voile and lawn at 80–110 GSM and rayon challis at 100–130 GSM.

items.heading: Cover-ups with stretch
paragraphs: If you want a cover-up with more body and stretch, we use performance knits at 140–180 GSM in place of the lighter non-stretch bases.

items.heading: Flowing dresses
paragraphs: Drapey rayon or viscose challis suits flowing maxi and tiered dresses, and modal and Tencel give you a softer hand.

items.heading: Structured and occasion dresses
paragraphs: Crisper cotton poplin or linen holds the shape of a structured shirt-dress. For bridesmaid, cocktail and evening styles, we offer polyester or silk chiffon and satin-type polyester or silk fabrics.

items.heading: Fabric changes print appearance
paragraphs: The same print looks brighter, softer or less sharp on chiffon, rayon, cotton and satin, and each base hangs differently in tiered, flowing and structured cuts.

items.heading: Tropical print themes
paragraphs: Our [Custom Print Design service](/custom-print-design/) creates designs exclusive to your group, using hibiscus, plumeria and other florals, monstera and palm foliage, beach scenes with sunsets or surfboards, and novelty themes.

items.heading: Printing and colour control
paragraphs: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-printing/) screen- or digital-prints rayon, cotton and linen before cutting. We limit sublimation to light-coloured polyester or blends with at least 60% polyester, and we hold your approved specifications, with colour within ΔE ≤ 2.0 and placement within 0.5 cm.

items.heading: Solid and custom shades
paragraphs: Our [Garment Dyeing service](/garment-dyeing/) works from Pantone Coated or stock colour cards and custom shades. Custom minimums depend on the fabric and dye method, we confirm feasibility during sampling, and we coordinate colour across fabric, lining and trims.

blocks.heading: How We Keep Dress Quality Consistent with Your Approved Sample
paragraphs: Once your dresses are pressed, we check them against your sealed approval sample, measuring hem level and key points. That catches any stretching or easing from sewing and pressing that cutting checks miss.
columns: What we control for your order
rows: We cut preshrunk rayon and other lightweight fabrics on the straight grain. Bias-cut and circular skirts hang for 24 hours so they drop before hemming, and then we finish them with a 0.5 cm rolled hem or a 1 cm double-turned hem.

Our [Quality Control service](/quality-control/) checks fabric, cutting and sewing, and you're welcome to bring in SGS or BV for inspections. We hold finished chest, length and waist within ±1 cm and small points within ±0.5 cm. Residual length and width shrinkage stays within 3% after three home washes. Washing colourfastness is Grade 4 or above, high-twist chiffon included, and rubbing and light fastness are Grade 3–4 or above. Rayon gets cold or 30°C gentle washing, no tumble drying and cool reverse ironing. Tested fabrics and trims carry OEKO-TEX Standard 100, organic cotton styles carry GOTS, cotton comes through Better Cotton (BCI), and our factory holds ISO 9001 and WRAP.

Our [Cut & Sew service](/cut-sew/) uses 1 cm overlocked or French seams on lightweight rayon, tested to ISO 13936-2 with no more than 6 mm seam opening. For silk and other very fine fabrics, we offer flat-felled side seams or narrow 0.6 cm French seams.

Under our [terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions/), you report any quality problem within 7 days with photos or videos. We review it and give you a solution within 24 hours: a repair, remake, replacement, discount or credit.

Our [Custom Labels & Hang Tags service](/custom-labels-hang-tags/) prepares fibre content, origin, care instructions based on wash tests, and any required RN or CA details from the actual materials, all for your artwork approval. We follow the rules of your destination, including US FTC, EU and UK fibre-name requirements and Australian care-labelling standards, and we check the labels on every private-label order.

blocks.heading: Related products and services
Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: What standard and plus-size ranges do your dresses come in, and what are the bust, waist, hip, bodice-length and finished-length measurements for each size?
items.answer: Standard sizes on this dress chart run XS to XL, plus sizes 2XL to 5XL. Every quote we send you includes a chart with the bust, waist, hip, bodice length and finished length for each size. For example, size M measures 92 cm at the bust, 74 cm at the waist and 98 cm at the hip, with a 40 cm bodice length. Bust, waist and hip go up by 5 cm per size in the standard sizes and by 6 cm per size in the plus sizes. In size M, finished lengths are about 85 cm for a mini, 115 cm for a midi and 140 cm for a maxi, and we adjust these to match your own chart.

items.question: Which closures and fit details can you add to a dress, such as zips, button plackets, elastic waists, adjustable straps, pockets or built-in bra cups?
items.answer: We can add any of these to any dress: concealed invisible zips at the centre back or side seam, button-front plackets, elastic or shirred waists, adjustable slider straps, tie straps and tie-backs. You can also ask for in-seam side pockets and built-in support, either a sewn-in shelf bra or removable foam cups in cup sizes A to D.

items.question: What relaxed and comfortably stretched bodice measurements can you give for each size of a smocked dress?
items.answer: Your spec sheet shows both measurements for every size. In size S, the bodice measures 62 cm relaxed and 92 cm comfortably stretched. Both figures go up by 5 cm per standard size and 6 cm per plus size. We set a tighter or looser stretch ratio to match the fit you need.

items.question: Can you line my Hawaiian dresses, fully or just at the bodice, so light rayon or cotton prints aren't see-through?
items.answer: Yes. You can choose full lining, bodice-only lining or a half lining to mid-thigh, in cotton voile, rayon or soft polyester, in matching or nude shades. With pale rayon or cotton prints, we check transparency during sampling, both in daylight and with backlighting. If the coverage isn't enough, we switch to a denser 120–140 gsm base or add a second bodice layer.

items.question: Which choices on a Hawaiian dress raise the cost most: length, tiers and ruffles, smocking, embroidery or lining?
items.answer: Length has the biggest effect on cost, because a maxi uses roughly twice as much fabric as a mini. Lining comes next because it adds a second layer of fabric. After that come extra tiers or ruffles, smocking and embroidery, which all add sewing time. Concealed zips, button plackets and pockets add less. To hit your target price, cut length, lining or the number of tiers first. That way you keep functional details such as closures, pockets and built-in support.

hero.heading: Muumuu Dress Manufacturer
lead: You get a coordinated collection for luau nights and cruise events, built around your own print.

cta.label: Request a quote for muumuu dresses

blocks.heading: Your Muumuu Dress Factory in China
paragraphs: We make muumuu dresses for resort shops, boutiques, hotel and gift stores, online retailers and other business buyers around the world. You can also build a coordinated print collection with us for hula groups, wedding parties, luau and cruise events, or matching families. We make muumuu dresses ourselves, in our own single factory in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China.

blocks.heading: OEM Muumuu Dress Design Options and Pricing
columns: What it means for your order
rows: Longer lengths, extra tiers, smocking and embroidery add fabric or sewing time, and fabric, lining and printing also affect the unit price. A rough-sketch quote changes when the finished design changes these requirements. We itemise each detail so you can see its cost and adjust your design.

Our [Hawaiian dress options](/hawaiian-dress-manufacturer/) cover sleeveless, halter, off-shoulder and puff-sleeve tops; wrap, A-line, tunic and loose-fit shapes; and smocked, tiered, ruffle and embroidered finishes.

Our [factory-owning company](/about-us/) has run the factory since 2011 and controls production and export directly for quality, cost and delivery. We take B2B orders only through this website and our team, with no online shop or third-party marketplace store.
Our in-house [Product Development](/product-development/) team builds OEM and ODM patterns, grading and fit from your design, picture or idea, which cuts down design back-and-forth.
Our [order process](/our-process/) begins with consultation, technical review and a tech pack. Sampling starts only after you agree the price, with separate sign-offs for sample and bulk approval.
You can [contact our English-speaking team](/contact-us/) by phone or video call at every stage, and we answer every enquiry within one business day.

Our [Matching Family & Group Sets](/matching-family-group-sets/) service runs from toddler sizes to 5XL and carries the same aloha print across garments, with the artwork scaled to each size so it lines up consistently.
Our [Cut & Sew](/cut-sew/) service makes your dresses from custom patterns and precisely cut panels.

Need a private label muumuu dress manufacturer? Our [Private Label](/private-label/) service is available at every order quantity and covers woven main and neck labels, printed labels, heat-transfer care and size labels, hang tags, branded metal tags, logos and silicone branding. We make [woven labels and transfers](/custom-labels-hang-tags/) in-house.

Our [Trims & Accessories](/trims-accessories/) service helps you pick button material, size, colour and attachment, plackets, packaging and brand details, with colour-matched metal, plastic, resin or eco-friendly accessories.

To [request a quote](/request-a-quote/), send specifications, sketches, a tech pack, detailed photos or references, or the garment type, sizes and quantities. We price the style, fabric, quantity, size range and customisation within 24 hours of receipt, and the quote is valid for 30 days from issue.

blocks.heading: Wholesale Muumuu Dresses, Order Minimums and Payment Terms

items.heading: Order minimum
items.text: Every order, in-stock dresses included, starts at 50 pieces per style in each colour, and stock orders can mix sizes. That keeps ordering within reach for small and growing labels.

items.heading: Available stock
items.text: We keep muumuu styles in stock for wholesale buyers. Ask us and we send you the current stock list so you can check which designs are available.

items.heading: Faster dispatch
items.text: In-stock dresses are already made and only need packing once you've paid in full. We dispatch them within 3 business days, so restocks stay quick.

items.heading: Stock or custom
items.text: Going with stock means giving up your own print, fabric and fit details in exchange for faster dispatch. Custom production gives you those choices, but sampling and bulk production have to come first.

items.heading: First trial run
items.text: We agree your first trial quantity case by case, and how flexible we can be depends on what production allows.

items.heading: Payment terms
items.text: You pay a 50% deposit when you confirm the order and the remaining 50% before shipment.

blocks.heading: Developing Your Dress Sample: Timing and Costs
rows: We have your standard sample ready in 10 to 15 days.
Each sample costs USD 50. On top of that, each design has a USD 50 design fee for its pattern or print, which covers all colourways. Neither fee is refunded or credited against your bulk order.

Our [Sampling](/sampling/) service makes one sample per style in size S or your chosen fit size to test fit, stretch and construction. We send it to you for approval and correct it where needed. Courier delivery costs you USD 50 on top of the sample fee.

blocks.heading: From Sample Approval to Production and Delivery

steps.heading: Production release
steps.text: Once you've approved the sample and we've received your deposit, your order goes into bulk production.

steps.heading: Bulk manufacturing
steps.text: Cutting, stitching and finishing your dresses takes 35 to 40 days. Order size and season set the production schedule.

steps.heading: Final inspection
steps.text: We give your finished order a full final inspection before it ships.

steps.heading: Shipping terms
steps.text: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. [DDP delivery is available worldwide](/shipping/), with duties, customs and freight in one price.

blocks.heading: Custom Muumuu Dress Fabrics, Colours and Prints
rows: We make your dresses in cotton, linen or chiffon, and we also work with wool blends and performance fabrics. You choose from a broad colour range to suit your collection.

Chiffon, voile, and white or pastel cotton and rayon muumuus need lining. Weight and shade decide how sheer a fabric is: a light or pale fabric that looks opaque on the roll shows through once it's sewn. We check the actual fabric in daylight, then agree the lining type and shade with you at sampling, along with the main fabric and colour.

You choose full, bodice-only or skirt lining. Skirt lining stops 5 cm above the hem. Options are cotton voile, polyester habotai or rayon in matching or skin-tone shades. Full lining gives complete coverage but makes the dress heavier and warmer in resort heat.
With our [Customisation](/customization/) service, we match print, thread and fabric dye colours to your Pantone references.

Our [Custom Print Design](/custom-print-design/) service creates florals for your group with hibiscus, plumeria and tropical blooms. It also does foliage with monstera, palm fronds and jungle leaves, beach scenes with sunsets, waves, surfboards and coastlines, and novelty prints.

Our [Custom Printing](/custom-printing/) service screen-prints or digitally prints rayon, cotton and linen on the roll before cutting. Rayon and cotton get saturated colour and a soft hand, and rayon keeps its fluid drape. Sublimation works only on light-coloured polyester and on blends of at least 60% polyester. It gives the sharpest brights and a smoother, crisper fall. Bulk uses your approved sample's method, fabric base and colour reference, with no changes unless you approve them in writing. Printed colour stays within ΔE ≤ 2.0 and placement within 0.5 cm. Repeats line up across the placket, pocket and hem with no visible break.

Our [Hawaiian Fabrics](/hawaiian-fabrics/) service offers 100% polyester chiffon and high-twist chiffon at 60–90 GSM, rayon challis at 100–130 GSM and cotton voile and lawn at 80–110 GSM. It also offers performance knits such as 95% polyester 5% spandex and 90% polyester 10% spandex at 140–180 GSM. Non-stretch chiffon, challis and voile give a flowing drape. Knits with 2-way or 4-way stretch of about 20–40% give an easy pull-on fit.

For navy, black and deep red, our [Garment Dyeing](/garment-dyeing/) service uses reactive dyes and a colour-fixing after-treatment. We check washing fastness and wet and dry rubbing fastness on the lab dip before you approve bulk.

blocks.heading: Muumuu Dress Sizing, Grading and Quality Standards
rows: We grade from your approved base sample to your own US, EU or UK size chart, using our muumuu range of XS to 3XL, plus sizes as on our [Hawaiian dresses](/hawaiian-dress-manufacturer/). Each style gets its own grading rules. Bust goes up 5 cm per size up to XL and 6 cm per size above XL. Length goes up 1 to 1.5 cm per size.
Checking samples in the smallest and largest sizes before bulk shows up grading problems. Those sizes are where the size steps add up the most, especially on loose or tiered cuts.

Our [Quality Control](/quality-control/) service checks fabric, print, fit, length, finish and packing against your brand's project standards. Checks run at incoming materials, cutting and sewing, then random checks and a full final inspection before dispatch. SGS or BV inspection is welcome. Coverage includes OEKO-TEX Standard 100 for tested fabrics and trims, GOTS for organic cotton styles, BCI for cotton sourcing, ISO 9001 for quality management and WRAP for social compliance. Finished chest, length and waist measurements stay within ±1 cm of your chart, and collar, cuff and other small points stay within ±0.5 cm. Preshrunk fabrics shrink no more than 3% in length and width after three home washes. Printed and dyed fabrics, high-twist chiffon included, reach Grade 4 or above for washing colourfastness and Grade 3–4 or above for rubbing and light. Rayon care is a cold or 30°C gentle wash, no tumble drying and a cool iron on the reverse side.

Under our [terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions/), we stay in touch after delivery. If you report a quality problem within 7 days with photos or videos, we review it and come back with a solution within 24 hours. That solution is a repair, remake, replacement, discount or credit.

Our [Custom Labels & Hang Tags](/custom-labels-hang-tags/) service drafts fibre content, care symbols and country of origin from the actual materials, and adds your RN or CA number where needed. Care instructions come from fabric and print wash tests. Labels follow the rules of the destination market, including US FTC, EU and UK fibre-name rules and Australian care-labelling standards. We send you the artwork to approve before production and check the labels on every private-label order.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Which dress lengths can you make, and can I set a custom length for each style?
items.answer: We make mini, knee, midi, maxi and ankle lengths, and each style can have its own custom length. Mini and knee lengths suit casual daywear and resort boutiques. Midi suits brunch and garden events, and maxi and ankle lengths suit luau, wedding and evening looks. Give each length in centimetres from the high shoulder point on your size chart, for example from 85 cm for a mini to 140 cm for an ankle length on size M. We fix the length at sampling.

items.question: Which closures, waist treatments and pockets can I choose for my muumuu dresses?
items.answer: You can pick elastic, smocked or drawstring waists, self-fabric tie belts, a back invisible zipper, front or back button plackets, or a pull-on design with no fastenings. We add side-seam pockets to almost any cut. We also make patch pockets in the main print or in a contrasting fabric.

items.question: Can you combine a contrasting yoke or bodice with a different skirt fabric, and what material combinations would you avoid?
items.answer: Yes. We pair a contrasting yoke or bodice with a different skirt fabric once both fabrics have been preshrunk and wash-tested together for shrinkage and colour bleed. We avoid pairings with very different shrinkage or care needs. Examples we make include a solid cotton bodice with a printed rayon skirt, or a linen yoke over a cotton voile skirt. We avoid silk with cotton, rayon with heavy polyester, and dark prints that bleed next to white panels. Mismatched shrinkage puckers the seams, and bleeding stains the panels next to it after washing.

items.question: Which muumuu cuts and details sell best for resort retail, and which should I start my line with?
items.answer: Our best sellers for resort retail are loose A-line and tiered maxi muumuus in printed rayon. Next come smocked-waist midi dresses and off-shoulder or puff-sleeve shapes with ruffle hems. A first line of 3 to 4 styles mixing maxi and midi cuts, in 2 to 3 prints each, gives you a focused retail test. Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. If you start with this small mix and reorder the styles that sell, you learn what your customers like without tying up money in slow-moving styles and colours.

seo.title: Swimwear Manufacturer | Design Support | Tapa Works
seo.description: Design support, recycled fabric options and performance testing from a swimwear manufacturer that makes your collection to order.

hero.heading: Swimwear Manufacturer
lead: We size your collection for cup-fitted, plus-size and children's ranges, so one supplier covers every customer.

cta.label: Request a quote for swimwear

blocks.heading: Custom Swimwear Made to Your Specifications
paragraphs: We make swimwear to your specifications, in the fabric, colours and patterns you choose, with bespoke embroidery too. You can choose from contemporary styles, bikinis, one-pieces, surf suits, rash guards, board shorts and neoprene pieces, and our range also covers cup-sized, plus-size and children's collections.

blocks.heading: Custom Swimwear Styles, Sizes and Fit Options

items.heading: Adult and children's sizes
paragraphs: Swimwear keeps its own chart: adult sizes XS to 3XL, plus sizes 1X to 5X, children's sizes 2T to 14 years and baby sizes 6 to 24 months.

items.heading: Cup-sized options
paragraphs: Our cup-sized one-pieces come in bands 30 to 40 (EU 65 to 90) and cups A to G. Our underwire tops come in cups B through E. All of them are graded from the fit sample you approve.

items.heading: Fit across your range
paragraphs: Once a mid-range fit sample is approved, we check the smallest and largest sizes separately before bulk. Proportional grading changes how the cup, leg opening and straps fit, and that causes gaping or digging at the ends of the size range.

items.heading: Pool and surf performance
paragraphs: For chlorine-heavy training, we use 100% polyester or polyester-spandex with chlorine-resistant elastic. For surf, we make rash guards, board shorts and neoprene pieces with flatlock or bonded seams.

items.heading: Bikini cuts
paragraphs: Our [bikini options](/bikini-manufacturer/) cover low-, mid- and high-rise bottoms, fixed, folded or tie-side waistbands, and every level of coverage from full to thong. The sampling reference you agree with us keeps bulk coverage consistent.

items.heading: Direct factory relationship
paragraphs: [Our company](/about-us/) has been operating since 2011, owns its factory and controls production and export directly. Every B2B order is agreed through our team, and we have no online shop or store on any third-party marketplace.

blocks.heading: Wholesale Swimwear Orders, Samples and Lead Times

items.heading: Minimum order
paragraphs: Orders start at 50 pieces per style in each colour. We agree first-trial quantities case by case within production constraints.

items.heading: Sample timing and cost
paragraphs: A standard sample takes 10 to 15 days and costs USD 50. The sample fee is not refunded or credited against your bulk order.

items.heading: Bulk timing and payment
paragraphs: Bulk production takes 35 to 40 days, depending on size and season. The clock starts once the sample is approved and we've received your 50% confirmation deposit. You pay the remaining 50% before shipment, after a full final inspection.

items.heading: Shipping terms
paragraphs: We ship on FOB, CIF or DDP terms. [DDP delivery is available worldwide](/shipping/), with duties, customs and freight in one price.

items.heading: Sampling service
paragraphs: Our [Sampling service](/sampling/) gives you one sample per style, in size S or the fit size you choose, so you can approve fit, stretch and construction and ask for corrections. You pay for courier delivery, which costs an extra USD 50.

items.heading: Separate approval stages
paragraphs: [Our process](/our-process/) starts with a quote you agree to before sampling. Sample approval is kept separate from bulk approval, and production begins once you've approved the design, materials, fit, branding and order details.

items.heading: Your itemised quote
paragraphs: We review your design, fabric, quantity, construction, lining, printing, branding, packaging, size ratio and lead time, then send you a no-obligation [itemised quote](/request-a-quote/) within 24 hours.

items.heading: Contact our team
paragraphs: [Our English-speaking team](/contact-us/) replies to every enquiry within one business day, and you can reach us by phone or video call throughout your order.

blocks.heading: Private Label Swimwear Design and Production Support

items.heading: Fully custom development
paragraphs: We design and make your pieces entirely to your brief. Our in-house pattern makers and technical designers develop bikini, one-piece and swim-trunk silhouettes from sketch through sampling.

items.heading: Fit decisions first
paragraphs: Send reference garments or fit preferences with your brief so we can fix the silhouette before cutting. A fit change after sampling needs new patterns and another sample round.

items.heading: Full-package production
paragraphs: Our full-package service takes you from concept and design through fabric sourcing to finished production. Hygienic liners for bottoms are included, and we brand those liners on orders over 3,000 units.

items.heading: Exclusive design ownership
paragraphs: Through our [Private Label service](/private-label/), you get exclusive design rights to each design, including all its colourways, once you pay the USD 50 fee per design. That fee is non-refundable and non-creditable. Our NDA protects prints based on your artwork from being resold.

items.heading: Technical development support
paragraphs: If you're looking for an OEM swimwear manufacturer to build to your existing specifications and tech pack, our [Product Development service](/product-development/) does exactly that. It also develops the tech pack for you, coordinates fabric mills, runs fit-sample rounds and prepares production markers for each size.

blocks.heading: Swimwear Fabric Choices and Recycled Materials
columns: What it means for your swimwear
rows: Nylon-spandex feels softer and drapes more smoothly. Polyester-spandex gives up some of that silky feel for better chlorine resistance and works better with sublimation. That's why you confirm your choice on a sewn sample under stretch, not on a flat swatch.

Our bases include 80% nylon / 20% spandex and polyester-spandex at 180 GSM or more. We check stretch at 130–170% lengthwise and 170–220% crosswise. You approve recovery and print sharpness before we use that construction for bulk.
You can choose ribbed knits, jacquards, lurex metallic weaves, UPF50+ fabrics and double-knit compression linings. Each one is selected for performance, stretch, UV resistance and service life.
We offer recycled nylon, ocean-regenerated nylon and regenerated elastane, and we cut with zero-waste pattern layouts.

We supply neoprene in 1.5 mm, 2 mm, 3 mm and 5 mm. 1.5–2 mm suits surf tops, rash vests and warm-water paddling. 3 mm suits spring suits for around 18–22°C. 5 mm with a plush lining suits water below 15°C.
You can specify nylon jersey on both faces, a smooth-skin outer face or a thermal plush lining.

Through our [Fabric Sourcing service](/fabric-sourcing/), existing jacquard, lurex and recycled fabrics stay at the garment minimum. Custom-developed jacquard or lurex starts at 1,000 metres per quality, and we confirm the exact minimum at sampling.

blocks.heading: Swimwear Prints and Colours That Suit Your Collection

items.heading: Sublimation requirements
paragraphs: Our ultra-HD sublimation uses paper transfer film and starts at 50 pieces per print. It needs light-coloured polyester or a blend with at least 60% polyester. It can't print white or lighten a dark ground.

items.heading: Prints under stretch
paragraphs: The dye goes into the polyester fibres, so the print moves with the fabric and doesn't crack. We stretch strike-offs over bust, hip and seat forms. Wherever white shows through, we deepen the ground colour or rescale the artwork before bulk.

items.heading: Existing solid colours
paragraphs: Custom dyeing isn't practical for swim fabrics, so you choose printing or stock shades. The stock shades include navy, black, white, ocean blue, emerald green, pink, coral, lavender, earth tones, neutrals and summer brights, and they're coordinated across fabric, lining and trims.

items.heading: Exclusive print development
paragraphs: Our [Custom Print Design service](/custom-print-design/) turns your sketches, moodboards or references into exclusive resort repeats. It covers colour separation, scaling for each garment, refined placement and 3D mockups.

items.heading: Matching across fabrics
paragraphs: For [Matching Family & Group Sets](/matching-family-group-sets/), different fibres render Pantone colours differently. You approve each base side by side against one reference, and we scale the artwork and sample the sets together, from toddler sizes up to 5XL.

items.heading: Production print adjustments
paragraphs: Our [Custom Printing service](/custom-printing/) adjusts repeat, scale and placement for each style and calibrates colours on stretch fabric to reduce deviation. It also gives you pre-production strike-offs to approve.

blocks.heading: Precision Swimwear Construction, Lining and Finishing

items.heading: Stitching and finishing
paragraphs: We build swimwear with four-needle six-thread flatlock stitching, seamless bonding and lining. Then we mark details, attach custom hardware and clean up edges under magnifying lenses.

items.heading: Lining choices
paragraphs: You choose full, front-only or self-fabric lining at sampling. Front-only lining makes the suit lighter and cheaper, but the back has less opacity and body. Power mesh at the front or tummy adds support.

items.heading: Bust support
paragraphs: Removable foam pads suit triangle and bandeau pockets, but they shift or fold and give little lift. For larger cups, we specify power mesh and sewn-in moulded cups, which keep their support under heavier loads.

items.heading: Swim-grade hardware
paragraphs: Rings, sliders, clasps and adjusters come in 316 stainless steel, zinc alloy with anti-corrosion plating, or high-strength nylon. Every opening is finished with chlorine-resistant rubber elastic, which keeps its stretch through repeated pool and seawater use.

items.heading: Embroidery placement
paragraphs: We keep embroidery under 8 cm across and put it on lower-stretch hips, waistbands or strap ends. We use a stitch density that works with stretch and a soft mesh or wash-away backing. We also cover the reverse with lining so it doesn't touch the skin.

items.heading: Buyer-supplied materials
paragraphs: For [Cut & Sew](/cut-sew/), your materials arrive before cutting, with 5–8% extra fabric and 3% spare trims and labels. We inspect everything when it arrives and report any shortages or defects within 2 business days, before we use it.

items.heading: Retail-ready packaging
paragraphs: Our [Packaging service](/packaging/) adds branded hygiene stickers to bottoms. It packs each piece in a self-seal or heat-sealed polybag with a branded closure sticker, ready for retail display.

items.heading: Nickel-release requirements
paragraphs: Our [metal trims and accessories](/trims-accessories/) meet the EU REACH nickel-release limit of 0.5 µg/cm²/week for prolonged skin contact. Nickel-free plating is available on request.

blocks.heading: Swimwear Performance Tests and Final Quality Checks
paragraphs: Dye lots and finishing vary between batches, so we repeat chlorine-resistance, colourfastness and elasticity tests on your bulk fabric lot and inspect every finished piece for stretch, print accuracy and size tolerance. Light shades get nude or matching linings and a wet-opacity check at sampling.

Before you order, our [Quality Control service](/quality-control/) confirms the certification that applies, including OEKO-TEX Standard 100, ISO 9001 and GRS documentation for certified recycled goods. We welcome independent inspectors and arrange paid tests at accredited laboratories, such as US flammability testing to 16 CFR Part 1610.
Our [Custom Labels & Hang Tags service](/custom-labels-hang-tags/) prepares compliant fibre, origin and care wording, adds your RN or CA number where required and sends you the artwork to approve.
Under our [terms and conditions](/terms-and-conditions/), you report quality problems within 7 days of delivery, and we offer a repair, remake, replacement, discount or credit.

items.author: Founder, Swimwear Label, Australia
